thread:
sam: quick flagging 1: we started seeing a regression after the kernel.autotune v3 rollout yesterday. p95 latency up ~25% for llama-70b long-context profiles and our longform QA coherence dropped ~1.8%

 eva: yikes. which rollout and any logs?

 deploy-bot: rollout complete: kernel.autotune_mode=aggressive -> 100% at 2025-11-12T03:12:08Z (ci/pipeline #4823) :truck:

 sam: gist: the selector is choosing tiled-attn for sequences >1024. that seems to bump kernel_selector CPU and also changed kv-cache layout/eviction behavior which spikes tail latency.

 perf-bot: quick perf snapshot (canary vs live):
 ```
 canary: p50=17ms p95=84ms CPU=(kernel_selector 29%, batcher 20%, kv_cache 14%, io 6%)
 live:   p50=19ms p95=105ms CPU=(kernel_selector 52%, batcher 12%, kv_cache 7%, io 6%)
 note: kernel_selector time ~x2 after autotune picks tiled path
 ```

 maria: can we break down by seq_len buckets? sounds like autotune mis-ranked for mid-long tails.

 alex: repro'd offline on our longform QA prompt corpus. perf repro OK. also saw subtle attention score drift when tiled-attn used vs fused-attn on the mixed mixtral/llama variant. small shifts in attention weights -> coherence loss on chain-of-thought answers.

 sam: so it's two-fold: perf (latency) and a quality regression tied to kernel swap + rope interpolation differences and head-splitting/quant path.

 eva: options: full rollback to pre-v3, or targeted mitigation (constrain autotune on certain buckets).

 jay: low-risk mitigation: set kernel.autotune_mode=conservative for seq_len>=1024 and route 10% traffic to that canary. should reduce selector churn and prefer fused-attn where it matters.

 maria: propose: 10% conservative canary -> run eval harness + perf traces -> decide. avoids global rollback.

 alex: additional finding: tiled path uses alternate KV memory layout; for models where num_heads % 8 != 0 we hit a head-split codepath that shortens eviction window and forces more recompute. patch idea: preserve legacy kv layout for those head-mod variants, unit-test eviction indices. will also add a microbench comparing tiled vs fused kv read/write.

 perf-bot: scheduled: eval-harness/longform on conservative canary (10%) -> results ETA ~45m

 sam: assignables: maria -> infra PR for canary flag; alex -> runtime PR for kv-layout compatibility + attention-diff test; eng-ml -> inspect attention diff outputs.

 maria: infra PR ready (infra#1298) to add a traffic-split + conservative tuning rule for seq_len>=1024. tagging @jay for fast rollback playbook if needed.

 alex: runtime PR created (runtime#857) with kv-layout toggle, unit tests, and a diff-run that computes L2 norm diffs on attention matrices for our eval set. also added a perf microbench for kernel_selector path.

 eng-ml-bot: alert conditions set: notify if coherence delta > 0.5% or hallucination rate increases by 0.3% on the harness.

 eva: good. if canary fixes perf but quality still regresses we should rollback autotune entirely. customer stability first.

 sam: please attach full profiler traces to PRs (/var/logs/serving/profiler/*canary*.json). also include sample attention matrices for a few failing prompts.

 jay: standing by. if rollback required I can cut to pre-v3 within 1 minute and revert the autotune config.

 sam: follow-ups in PR threads. thanks all :thumbsup:
